input_geometry_convention.units: m; official evaluator multiplies raw XYZ mean error by 100 to report centimeters
input_geometry_convention.coordinate_frame: camera-relative projection frame inferred from official use of K; encoder preserves published XYZ
input_geometry_convention.formal_origin_axes_handedness: origin, axis signs, and handedness not explicitly specified in inspected official sources

orientation.anatomical_axis_convention: not an anatomical canonical frame; do not rotate or reflect without an approved transform

physical_scale: not embedded; retain upstream inverse-transform metadata and meter-valued reference-bone scale

resolution_selection.selection_basis: largest tested resolution within declared tensor-payload and runtime budgets while preserving all named landmark channels

channels.name: vertex_or_surface_occupancy
channels.meaning: 1 for cells hit by an input vertex or deterministic sample on an input triangle; FreiHAND annotations currently provide no faces, so validation marks vertices

channels.name: named_freihand_keypoint_occupancy
channels.meaning: one channel for each keypoint in FREIHAND_KEYPOINT_NAMES order; identity remains encoded when landmarks share an XYZ cell

triangle_sampling: deterministic barycentric lattice; longest-edge spacing at most half a voxel width
decoder: occupied cell centers only; lossy point approximation

prototype_engineering_checks.normalization: multiply normalized error bounds by per-sample GeometryTransform.scale to report source meters

limitations: point/depth/fingertip-separation tolerances are not clinically approved
50 real FreiHAND training samples passed prototype normalization and encoder checks; this is not clinical validation
vertices-only input does not reconstruct surface between vertices
FreiHAND archive contains no faces or anatomical surface-region labels; MANO topology requires authorized asset and vertex-correspondence validation
camera-frame origin, axis signs, and handedness remain unspecified in inspected official references
topology, normals, signed distance, absolute scale, and true inter-surface finger clearance are not encoded
